Family Planz

The official Family Planz app repository. Shared calendar, tasks, and groceries that keep your family on one page. Same app as https://familyplanz.com.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://familyplanz.com/fdroid/repo
